description: Building the material a step needs, often what the champion carries into rooms the person won't be in: use this when the person picked an asset from Andru's catalog (find it with list_assets), e.g. 'Board Presentation', 'Buying Committee Navigation'. Built from everything Andru knows about their company and saved to their Andru library. Takes up to a few minutes: returns a job_id; call get_asset with it to receive the asset as markdown.

prospectCompany.description: For a prospect asset (Pre-Call Intelligence Brief, Deal Reengagement Strategy, Personalized Cost of Inaction One-Pager): the company it is for.

prospectContact.description: For a prospect asset: the person it is for, name and title.
